content.introduction: The S&P 500 closed at 51,307.10, down 214.2 points or 0.42%, according to Investing.com. The US Tech 100 rose by 29.5 points or 0.40% to 7,383.30, while the Dow Jones increased by 377.6 points or 1.42% to 27,007.40. The S&P 500 VIX fell by 2.54 points or 9.01% to 25.64. The Dollar Index went up by 0.750 points or 0.74% to 102.18. Crude Oil WTI Futures dropped by 0.18 points or 0.20% to 90.34, and Brent Oil Futures decreased by 0.54 points or 0.55% to 97.75.
